BandFuse - Rock Legends.name: BandFuse: Rock Legends
BandFuse - Rock Legends.summary: BandFuse: Rock Legends provides a pick up and play experience for musicians of all skill levels. Whether you've never held a guitar or bass before or you are already lead guitarist in your own band, BandFuse: Rock Legends will have you rockin' with your favorite songs in minutes. BandFuse: Rock Legends connects REAL guitars, bass and microphones to your game console, unleashing a full band experience for players of all skill levels.

Don Bradman Cricket 14.name: Don Bradman Cricket 14
Don Bradman Cricket 14.summary: The first thing to think about when you start playing Don Bradman Cricket 14 is to forget what you know about Cricket games and start afresh…it's cricket like you've never seen it before!

Dragon's Dogma - Dark Arisen.name: Dragon's Dogma: Dark Arisen
Dragon's Dogma - Dark Arisen.summary: An open-world action role-playing game set in the high-fantasy land of Gransys. Players create a customizable protagonist and explore the world in real-time combat, choosing among vocations such as fighter, mage, and strider. A defining feature is the Pawn system, AI companions who fight alongside the player, offer advice, and can be shared with other players online. Combat lets characters grapple and climb large monsters to reach vulnerable spots. Dark Arisen is an expanded edition of the original Dragon's Dogma that adds the Bitterblack Isle area with new high-level enemies, quests, and equipment.

Metal Gear Solid - HD Edition.name: Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker - HD Edition
Metal Gear Solid - HD Edition.summary:
Stories tell of a legendary soldier who, with Metal Gear in his command, had once waged war against the world. His name was Naked Snake, a.k.a. Big Boss. Now, in response to a world hungry for answers, the truth behind this legend will finally be told.
Developed by legendary Hideo Kojima -- the mastermind behind the most successful video game tactical-espionage series of all time -- this game lets players take control of the famed Naked Snake at a critical junction in modern history. Advanced co-operative techniques allows multiple players to sneak into the fray and accomplish the mission together.

NBA Live 10.name: NBA Live 10
NBA Live 10.summary: NBA Live 10 is the 2009 installment in the NBA Live series, developed by EA Canada and published by Electronic Arts. Dwight Howard of the Orlando Magic is the cover athlete. It was released in 2009 for PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, PSP and iOS (the latter under the title NBA Live by EA Sports).[1] NBA Live 10 was to be followed by NBA Live 13 which was cancelled in late 2012. NBA Live 10 was the last game in the NBA Live series for 4 years until NBA Live 14 in 2013.
